title: primula × weldeniana
intro: Primula × weldeniana, commonly known as Welden's primrose, is a hybrid plant species within the Primula genus, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and distinctive foliage. Primula × weldeniana has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as potential relief from respiratory issues and stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and soothe respiratory tract issues. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other volatile compounds, contribute to its medicinal properties.
